x: Easton, Jack and Bert Field, and F. Ford, who was attendant to Jimmie Bellchamber in the Brighton Walk of 1921! ! !
F.Ford,H.Fearn,----,C.Barrington, R.J.Savage(14),J.J.Crichton(22), A.L.Porter,E.Musselbrook(15),-------, E.T.Coxall, HARRY PARKER(17), E.Cope(Vice President), A.Fraser(20), H.

While he never competed himself, he and another P.A.C. man, Fred Ford, were stalwart supporters of the Bels. As a matter of fact, Harry Fearn was with me at my first club evening meeting at Stamford Bridge, in which I competed in 1912 and placed in the Novice Mile.
